content.text: Solomon e cingthuilawk: Capa a lungkaang e ni teh,
a na pa a lunghawi sak. Hatei, capa ka pathu e teh,
a manu lung ka mathout sakkung doeh.
Thoenae lahoi pâkhueng e hnopai teh, hawinae awmhoeh.
Hatei, lannae ni teh duenae koehoi a rungngang.
BAWIPA ni tamikalannaw a pasai teh,
tamikathoutnaw ngainae hah a tâkhawng pouh.
Pangaknae ni mathoenae a tâco sak teh,
hratbatnae ni tawntanae a tâcokhai.
Kawmpoi tueng navah rawca ka pâkhueng e teh,
a lungkaang e capa doeh.
Canga lahun nah ka ip e capa teh
yeirai ka po sakkung doeh.
Tamikalan lû dawk yawhawinae ao teh,
tamikathoutnaw e pahni teh rektapnae hoi akawi.
Tamikalannaw pahnimhoehnae heh yawhawinae lah ao han.
Hatei, tamikathoutnaw e min teh a pawk han.
Tami lungkaang ni teh kâpoelawknaw a lungthin hoi a dâw,
hatei, a lawk kapap e tamipathu teh a rawp han.
Lannae lahoi ka cet e tami teh karoumcalah a cei,
hatei lam longkawi ka dawn e teh panue lah ao han.
Mit cumasipnae ni lungmathoenae a tâco sak,
lawk kapap e tamipathu teh a rawk han.
Tamikalan e pahni teh hringnae tuiphuek doeh.
Hatei, tami kahawihoehnaw e pahni teh moikainae ni a ramuk.
Hmuhmanae ni kâpohoehnae a tâco sak.
Hatei, lungpatawnae niteh, yonnae pueng a ramuk pouh.
Thaipanueknae ka tawn e pahni dawk
lungangnae hah hmu e lah a o,
hatei, hemnae bongpai teh
thaipanueknae ka tawn hoeh e a hnukthun vah a bo.
Tami a lungkaangnaw niteh, thoumthainae heh a pâkhueng awh,
hatei, tamipathu e pahni niteh, rawknae hah a hnai.
Tami katawntanaw hanelah teh,
a tawntanae hah ka cak e khopui lah ao teh,
tamimathoenaw rawknae teh, a mathoenae doeh .
Tamikalan thaw tawknae ni hringnae a tâcokhai teh,
tamikathoutnaw e tawkphu teh, thoe khangnae hah doeh.
Cangkhainae ka tarawi e teh, hringnae lamthung dawk ao.
Hatei, yuenae ka ek e teh, lamthung ka phen e doeh.
Hmuhmanae hah laithoe deinae pahni hoi ka ramuk e tami,
ayâ min mathoe nahanelah ka dei e tami teh tamipathu doeh.
Lawk pap pawiteh, payon e hai a pap.
Hatei, a pahni ka cakuep e tami teh tami a lungkaang e doeh.
Tamikalan e lai teh, kahawi e ngun patetlah ao teh,
tamikathout e lungthin teh aphu awm hoeh.
Tamikalan e pahni ni tami moikapap a kawk.
Hatei, tamipathu teh lungangnae a vout dawkvah a due.
BAWIPA yawhawinae ni tami a tawnta sak teh,
lungmathoenae thokhai boihoeh.
Tamipathu hanelah teh, yonnae sak e heh a nawmnae lah a coung.
Hatei, thaipanueknae ka tawn e niteh, lungangnae a tawn.
Tamikathout teh a taki e patetlah a lathueng a pha vaiteh,
tamikalan teh a ngai e hah poe lah ao han.
Bongparui a kâkaven toteh, tamikathoutnaw teh a kahma han.
Hatei, tamikalan ni teh a yungyoe adu hungnae a tawn.
Tami pangak patoun e teh, misurtui kathut e ni hah a kip sak e hoi,
hmaikhu ni mit a ut e patetlah doeh ao.
BAWIPA takinae ni hringyung a saw sak, hatei,
tamikathout e hringyung teh duem sak lah ao han.
Tamikalan ni ngaihawi e teh lunghawinae lah ao,
hatei, tamikathout e ngaihawinae teh a kahma han.
Tamikalan hanelah BAWIPA e lamthung teh thaonae doeh.
Hatei, thoenae ka sak e teh, rawkkahmanae koe a pha han.
Tamikalan teh hmuen dawk hoi nâtuek hai puen lah awm mahoeh.
Hatei, tamikathoutnaw ni talai heh onae lah hno awh mahoeh
Tamikalan e pahni ni lungangnae a tâcokhai,
hatei ka longkawi e lai teh, tâtueng pouh lah ao han.
Tamikalan e pahni ni ngai kawi e hno hah a panue,
hatei tamikathout e pahni niteh,
kâtarannae lawk doeh ouk a dei.
